guardian.name: Old Grumblebark
phases: g:Harrumph! My leaves have gone grey and so has my mood!
g:Stop it. I am NOT smiling. That is just how my bark sits.
g:Oh no. I can feel a giggle coming. Hold it in, Grumblebark!
befriended: g:Ha ha ha! I have not laughed in a hundred years!
g:Take the crystal fragment. And come back for a story, little ones.
o:A talking tree who tells stories? Best. Day. Ever.

levels.title: Bubble Glade
intro: o:Look, Mosey! Word bubbles are stuck in the trees.
m:Fill in the missing letters and they will pop!
o:Popping things is my favourite subject.
outro: m:Look! The flowers are waking up.
o:Our answers bring the colour back!

levels.title: Mushroom Canyon
intro: o:Uh oh. The bridge has vanished!
m:Each right answer builds a rainbow plank.
o:Then I shall walk on rainbows. Naturally.
outro: o:I crossed a rainbow! My feet feel fizzy.

levels.title: River Dash
intro: m:Hop on, Otter. The river is the fastest way.
o:Type the words to make us zoom!
m:Hold on to my frills. Gently!
outro: o:Again! Again!
m:Maybe after a snack.
levels.blurb: Type to zoom down the river

levels.title: Firefly Hollow
intro: m:The fireflies have lost their glow.
o:Tricky words ahead. I love tricky words!
m:You love ALL words.
outro: o:Every firefly is glowing again!

levels.title: Old Grumblebark
intro: g:WHO is making all that cheerful noise in MY woods?
o:Hello, Mr Tree! We are looking for a crystal fragment.
g:Bah! Spell my word muddles first. If you can!
outro: m:One fragment found. Five to go!
o:The whole wood is green again!

guardian.name: Inky
phases: g:Eight arms… or is it nine? I have lost count of EVERYTHING!
g:Wait, that helps! But now my sums are all in a knot.
g:Nearly untangled! Do I add this arm or take it away?
befriended: g:Eight! I have EIGHT arms! Thank you, clever friends!
g:Here, I was sitting on this shiny thing.
m:That is the crystal fragment! Good sitting, Inky.

levels.title: Coral Tunnels
intro: m:Welcome to my favourite place. Maths under the sea!
o:Which tunnel do we take?
m:The one with the right answer. Follow me!
outro: o:You swim so fast when you are right!
m:Maths makes me zoomy.

levels.title: Pearl Bridge
intro: o:A canyon. Under the sea. How?
m:Do not ask how. Ask how many!
o:Fine. Rainbow bridge time.
outro: m:A rainbow under water. Now I have seen everything.

levels.title: Sunken Treasure
intro: o:Treasure chests! But they are locked.
m:Type the answer to pop each lock.
o:I hope one is full of fish biscuits.
outro: o:No fish biscuits. But look at all these new friends!

levels.title: Shipwreck Sprint
intro: m:The old shipwreck! Stay close, Otter.
o:I am not scared. You are scared.
m:I am a mosasaur. I am never scared.
outro: o:We made it! Was that a ghost?
m:That was a jellyfish in a hat.

levels.title: Inky the Octopus
intro: g:Oh dear, oh dear. Is that two visitors or twelve?
m:Just two, Inky. Are you feeling muddled?
g:Terribly! Help me sort my sums out!
outro: o:Two fragments! We make a brilliant team.
m:The reef is glowing again!

guardian.name: Sir Scorch
phases: g:Behold my mighty fl… is something burning?
g:It is my TROUSERS! Again! Quick, distract me with times tables!
g:Still a bit toasty back there. One more round!
befriended: m:Hold still, Sir Scorch. One splash coming up!
g:Ahhh. Thank you. These were my best trousers.
g:Take the fragment. It was making my pocket itchy.

levels.title: Dragon Egg Rescue
intro: o:Dragon eggs! They are getting cold.
m:Type the answer to hatch each one.
o:Come out, little dragons!
outro: o:They think I am their mum.
m:You do have the right hair.

levels.title: Hot Spring Rapids
intro: m:A warm river. Lovely for my flippers.
o:Times tables tunnels ahead!
m:Count in jumps if you get stuck.
outro: m:That was like a bubbly bath. With maths.

levels.title: Lava Bridge
intro: o:That lava looks very… lava-y.
m:Then let us not fall in. Bridge time!
o:Rainbow planks, do your thing.
outro: o:My tail did not get toasted. Success!

levels.title: Crystal Cave Nest
intro: m:More eggs, deep in the crystal cave.
o:These ones are trickier.
m:Good. Tricky makes us clever.
outro: o:So many dragons. I need more arms for cuddles.

levels.title: Sir Scorch
intro: g:Halt! I am Sir Scorch, the fearsome… ouch. Warm.
o:Excuse me. Your trousers are on fire.
g:Nonsense! Dragons do not… oh. OH! Not again!
outro: m:Three fragments. Halfway there!
o:And nobody got toasted.

islands.name: Cloud Castle
islands.tagline: Type your way through the sky

guardian.name: Nimbus
phases: g:Tee hee! I jumbled all the words in the sky!
g:Hey! Stop fixing things! Take THAT word muddle!
g:My best spell! Nobody can… oh. You can.
befriended: g:All right, all right. You win. That was fun!
g:Nobody ever plays with me up here.
o:Then come and play with us! After you hand over the fragment.

levels.title: Sky Sprint
intro: o:We are flying! On a cloud! Mosey, you are flying!
m:I am a sky mosasaur now. Type to keep us going!
outro: m:Flying is just swimming with extra air.

levels.title: Cloud Bubbles
intro: o:Word bubbles, all the way up here!
m:These words have special endings.
o:Endings are my second favourite. After beginnings.
outro: o:Pop, pop, pop. The sky is turning blue again!

levels.title: Cloud Steps
intro: m:Some words sound the same but mean different things.
o:Like 'sea' and 'see'!
m:Pick the right one to build each cloud step.
outro: o:I can SEE the SEA from here. Ha!

levels.title: Portal Race
intro: m:The castle portal is opening!
o:Fast fingers, careful fingers!
m:Careful first. Fast comes later.
outro: o:We made it through! My whiskers are tingling.

levels.title: Nimbus the Cloud Wizard
intro: g:Ooh, visitors! Want to see a trick?
o:Is it a nice trick?
g:Nope! It is a WORD MUDDLE! Tee hee!
outro: m:Four fragments. The sky is clear!
o:And we made a new friend.

guardian.name: Puff
phases: g:MINE! All the sweets are MINE! …How many is that?
g:Sharing? What is sharing? Show Puff!
g:Half for you, half for me… Puff is getting it!
befriended: g:Sharing makes the sweets taste BETTER!
g:Puff shares the shiny thing too.
m:The fragment! Thank you, Puff. Fair shares all round.

levels.title: Sweet Shop Jars
intro: o:Everything here is made of SWEETS.
m:Do not lick the scenery, Otter.
o:Too late. Let us open these jars by sharing equally!
outro: o:Fair shares for everyone. Mostly me.

levels.title: Chocolate River
intro: m:A chocolate river. I may never leave.
o:Fraction tunnels ahead!
m:Half of a thing is that thing shared by two.
outro: m:I am now one quarter chocolate.

levels.title: Biscuit Bridge
intro: o:The biscuit bridge got nibbled.
m:Somebody had a midnight snack.
o:It was not me. This time.
outro: o:A rainbow biscuit bridge. Can I keep it?

levels.title: Fudge Falls
intro: m:Hold your nose. We are going under the fudge falls.
o:Best. Waterfall. Ever.
outro: o:I have fudge in my ears.
m:Save some for later.

levels.title: Puff the Marshmallow
intro: g:PUFF is the biggest! Puff keeps ALL the sweets!
m:That does not sound very fair, Puff.
g:Fair? Puff does not know how to share!
outro: o:Five fragments! Only one left.
m:And it is on Starlight Island.

guardian.name: Umbra
phases: g:Go away. Shadows do not have friends.
g:Why are you being kind to me? It makes me feel… warm.
g:If the crystal comes back… will I disappear?
befriended: m:You will not disappear, Umbra. Shadows need the light.
o:And friends need friends. Come with us!
g:I… I would like that. Here. I kept it safe for you.

levels.title: Star Bubbles
intro: o:The stars have gone dim.
m:Every word we spell lights one up.
o:Then let us light the whole sky!
outro: m:Look at them twinkle.

levels.title: Comet Chase
intro: m:We can swim through stardust up here!
o:Is it sticky?
m:Only a little. Tunnels ahead!
outro: o:I have stardust in my scarf. Fancy.

levels.title: Rocket Words
intro: o:To the last portal!
m:Type carefully and we will fly straight.
outro: m:That was our best flying yet.

levels.title: Constellation Bridge
intro: o:One last bridge, made of stars.
m:Words and numbers together this time.
o:Our two favourite things!
outro: o:We built a bridge out of STARS, Mosey.

levels.title: Umbra the Shadow
intro: g:You came all this way for a crystal?
o:And to find out who broke it.
g:I did not mean to. I only wanted to hold something bright.
outro: n:The six fragments joined together, and colour rushed across every island.
o:We did it, Mosey!
m:We did it together. That is the real magic.

intro: n:One sunny morning on Rainbow Island…
o:Mosey! I spelled 'breakfast' in the sand. Now I am hungry.
m:You are always hungry. That is three breakfasts today.
o:Three is a very good number.
n:Suddenly, the Great Rainbow Crystal began to shake…
n:CRACK! It shattered into six fragments and flew across the sea!
m:Otter… the colours are fading!
o:The flowers have gone grey. We have to fix this!
m:Look, a word bubble by that flower. Try the missing letter!
introAfter: o:It bloomed! The colour came back!
m:So our answers bring the world back to life.
o:Six islands. Six fragments. One snack break. Let us go!
